producer_report.summary: DefaultsModel::render (the reader form) now emits only the first sentence of each statement. A sentence ends at the first ". "; statements with no such break, including ';' and ', and' ones, stay whole. get() still returns the full statements for producer/verifier briefs. defaults.toml gains a multi-sentence 'root-cause' entry; the diff adds lines only, so the existing entries are byte-identical. The CHANGELOG entry adds 'root-cause' and mentions the compact reader rendering. The first run was 9 tokens over the reader's 1800 budget (1809). I shortened the new entry's first sentence to "Fix the root cause, not the symptom or the one instance that surfaced." and set applies_to to ["*"] instead of listing code, config, build. The reader is now within budget. I did not touch the design doc, reading.rs, budgets.rs, athena.toml or BRIEF.md.

checks_run.note: applied formatting; I did not run --check separately
budgets test failed: reader set 1809 tokens vs 1800
